question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id 
    FROM shopping_cart_events e 
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id 
    WHERE ph.page_id = 13 AND e.event_type = 3
),
product_views AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(ph.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        ph.page_name,
        ph.product_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.page_name, ph.product_category
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(ph.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        ph.page_name,
        ph.product_category,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.page_name, ph.product_category
)
SELECT 
    pv.product_id,
    pv.page_name,
    pv.product_category,
    pv.view_count,
    pv.add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(pp.purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count,
    pv.add_to_cart_count - COALESCE(pp.purchase_count, 0) AS left_in_cart
FROM product_views pv
LEFT JOIN product_purchases pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id AND pv.page_name = pp.page_name AND pv.product_category = pp.product_category
ORDER BY pv.product_id
